common: Create realistic, production-quality UI designs with clear hierarchy, strong typography and purposeful spacing. Use case ui-mockup. Desktop Chinese internal enterprise data operations application "业务数据运营平台". Core screen "政策基础标签表", for operators finding and maintaining policy records, permissions enforced. Existing screenshot attached is reference image for real functionality and existing navy/blue visual identity, redesign layout intentionally. Target dimensions 1440 x 1024. Current date 2026-09-20, sample record dates preserve 2025-06-11, 2022-08-16, 2021-10-08. All interface text simplified Chinese. Mature professional calm Vue Element Plus enterprise UI, readable 14-16px body, 24px heading, PingFang SC-like typography, tabular numerals. Palette navy #203955, primary #2c68bb, ink #20324c, muted #697386, surface #fff, background #f3f6fa, border #e3e9f1. Prioritize alignment spacing and typography, simple row separators; minimal shadows, 6px controls, no decorative hero, no charts, no KPI cards, no fake approval pipeline, no AI assistant, no invented workflow status. Label boolean column "是否解读" with "是"/"否"; it does NOT mean completed/pending. Preserve all data via detail/column controls, don't display 20 columns at once. Show total 1,870 records and page 1 of 94, 20 per page, 8-10 visible rows. Names: "推动食品工业数字化转型实施方案", "“十四五”文化发展规划", "“十四五”体育发展规划", "“十四五”现代综合交通运输体系发展规划", "“十四五”铁路科技创新规划", "“数字住建”建设整体布局规划", "2030年前碳达峰行动方案", "“十四五”国家信息化规划". Sample types 信息化建设类, 顶层规划类, 产业政策类. Core columns policy title with issuer as secondary line, 地区, 政策类型, 出台时间, 是否解读, 操作 (查看/编辑). Controls 新增政策 (one primary), 导入 Excel, 更多 (export and audit remain accessible), title search with clear button, 省份, 政策类型 and 更多筛选 for boolean filters. No bulk destructive actions. Breadcrumb 工作台 / 政策 / 政策基础标签. Existing sidebar modules workbench, 政策 with 信源管理/政策基础标签/政策解读, 码表管理, 系统管理. Future customer/tender modules are not yet published and MUST NOT be visible as active menu items. This mock uses sample presentation, tiny unobtrusive "设计样板 · 示例数据" at bottom. App content only, no browser chrome or devices. Focus the primary screen and one main task, not a feature inventory. No cards inside cards. No imagery needed. Don't crowd or clip content. Each output is one independent full screen.

directions.prompt: Direction name: 蓝色数据工作台. Preserve navy 216px vertical navigation, pale main canvas, slim 56px white topbar. Spacious direct page heading on background (not a card), subtitle then ONE white integrated work surface grouping compact horizontal search/filter toolbar, a concise results line with total, then wide excellent readable table. Table occupies most of screen. Give title column around 440px, dates numeric, small pale outlined boolean labels, fixed right row actions. Table header and footer restrained. Desktop 1440x1024, no side detail panel. Visual signature is policy title + issuer two-line hierarchy with aligned compact classification, reliable quiet data workbench.

Direction name: 分栏核对台. Same mature navy-blue identity but use very light gray compact 184px left navigation, a dark navy thin top brand bar. Distinct composition: a horizontal search toolbar on white background at top of main area and underneath a master/detail workspace: 65% width concise policy list/table with policy title + issuer, region, whether interpretation and row action; 35% persistent read-only detail pane for selected policy with prominent full title, source link, then labeled blocks 政策基础信息 / 所属地区 / 业务标签, and 修改信息 as secondary to global 新增政策. Selected row blue-tinted with a precise left line. Detail pane labeled 政策详情 with close control. Long title readable. No modal backdrop. No fake data quality metrics. Show clear distinction between read-only record inspection and actual editing. Each row is part of one continuous table, not cards. Main heading 24px. Table shows 8 rows and footer pagination. Include whitespace and hairline separators, fewer borders, no gradients. One desktop screen 1440x1024.

Direction name: 模块化宽屏台账. Distinct navigation strategy designed for future many modules: slim navy global header with full product name on left, top-level tabs 工作台 / 政策 (active) / 码表管理 / 系统管理, user menu at far right. Under header a white secondary horizontal nav 信源管理 / 政策基础标签 (active) / 政策解读. NO sidebar, giving full width to dense professional data maintenance. Main work surface uses flat pale-gray page, compact heading with total, primary 新增政策 on right beside 导入 Excel and 更多. Single-line concise filters under heading then wide table begins early. Table readable and clean, 12 records in viewport, 56px row height, policy title 490px with issuer below, region, policy type, date, 是否穿透, 是否解读, 操作. Minimal vertical gridlines, subtle horizontal separators. Compact 14px body, calm blue accent, no decorative hero/metrics. Signature strong horizontal modular navigation plus wide content suitable for later customer/tender modules (do NOT show unpublished modules in this current runtime sample). Footer aligned pagination. Strictly show only existing source fields, never invent document numbers, validity states or task lifecycle. This is a single desktop full screen 1440x1024, not collage.
